title: Assignments
content:
You are required to submit three short writing assignments (approximately 500–1000 words each) over the course of the semester. These are worth 15% of your final grade each. You will also be required to submit a single longer essay (approximately 1500 words) due on the final day of class. This is worth 30% of your final grade. For further detail, see:
Short Writing Assignment 1
Short Writing Assignment 2
Short Writing Assignment 3
Final Essay
